content.short: Rysk is an options protocol letting holders earn upfront yield on crypto assets.
content.description: Rysk is a volatility yield protocol that pays asset holders upfront for writing covered calls and cash-secured puts. A user picks a strike and expiry to set their own yield and risk, confirms, and the premium is transferred to their wallet immediately as the trade executes on-chain. Positions are fully collateralised with no liquidation risk and no counterparty exposure. It supports ETH, BTC, HYPE, liquid staking and restaking tokens and other listed assets.
content.meta: Rysk is a Hyperliquid options protocol letting holders earn upfront yield on crypto assets.
